seo.title: Solar panels with battery in the Alpes-Maritimes | Soliance
seo.description: Solar panels with battery storage in the Alpes-Maritimes and the Var: detailed study, fixed quote, installation by our own technicians, paperwork included.

hero.title: Solar panels and battery: produce by day, consume in the evening.
hero.lead: No more self-consumption bonus and a surplus bought back at €0.01/kWh: every kilowatt-hour you do not use is lost. That is why all our residential installations include a battery, and are sized after a detailed study of your consumption, your household and your home.
hero.imageAlt: Sea-view villa in Roquebrune-sur-Argens, panels on the roof and a swimming pool

autonomy.label: energy self-sufficiency with a battery, depending on the household profile

coverage.label: of installations with a physical battery and a prior study

installation.label: of installation depending on the power, by our own teams

paperwork.label: for you to handle: town hall, Enedis, Consuel, buy-back contract

sizes.title: Three sizes, all with a battery
sizes.footnote: Power and battery size are never chosen as a package: they come out of the study. Price given on quotation, fixed and itemised line by line, first-year maintenance included.

small.title: Household of 2 to 3 people
small.description: 6 to 12 panels, a Solax IES hybrid inverter and a battery sized on your evening consumption. For a bill of €100 to €200 per month.
small.imageAlt: Small 4 kWp installation in Villeneuve-Loubet, with the sea in the background

features.quote: Fixed study and quote, no fictitious bonus

medium.title: Family, pool or air conditioning
medium.description: The most common setup: 10 to 15 kWh of storage to cover the evening and the night, an EPS box to keep the essentials running during a power cut, control of the water heater or the charger.
medium.imageAlt: Villa in Saint-Jeannet, 6 kWp on the garage and the awning

features.absence: Ideal if you are away during the day

large.tag: 9 – 12 kWp and more · 15 kWh battery and more
large.title: Large house, three-phase
large.description: Villas, heat pump, two electric vehicles, outbuildings. Three-phase inverter, expandable storage, VAT recovery on request. Beyond that, see our professional solutions.
large.imageAlt: Large villa with a pool, panels spread over several roof sections and the pool house

method.title: A detailed study for 100% of installations. No standard kit.
method.intro: Two neighbouring houses never have the same installation. We measure before we propose.
method.footnote: Result: a fixed quote stating the power, the battery capacity and the expected self-sufficiency rate — then checked by Soliance Care supervision once the installation is running.

consumption.title: The real figures, hour by hour
consumption.description: Bills from the last 12 months, Linky load curve, seasonality: we know what you consume and when, so the battery is sized on your actual evenings.

household.title: Who lives there, and how
household.description: Number of people, presence during the day, heating, hot water, pool, air conditioning, electric vehicle, future projects: the profile decides the power and the storage.

house.title: The roof, the grid, the shading
house.description: Orientation, pitch, roofing, shading, electrical panel, single or three-phase, battery location: the technical visit locks every point before the quote.

hardware.title: Components we know inside out.
hardware.body: We have been installing and servicing the same brands since 2022: we know what lasts, and we handle manufacturer warranties ourselves if something goes wrong.
hardware.imageAlt: Solax IES X3 hybrid inverter and battery installed on a project in Vence

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Francilienne 450 to 500 W, a French brand, 25-year product warranty

inverters.title: Inverters
inverters.description: All-in-one Solax IES (single or three-phase) or Solax micro-inverters

batteries.title: Batteries & backup
batteries.description: Solax IES batteries, T30 / T58 on every installation, EPS box for backup power

mounting.title: Mounting & safety
mounting.description: K2 systems, AC/DC protection boxes, Consuel on every installation

selfConsumptionBonus.title: Self-consumption bonus: none active to date
selfConsumptionBonus.description: The scheme is closed. We do not include it in our quotes; if it is reactivated, it will be deducted at signature.

surplus.title: Surplus bought back at €0.01 per kWh
surplus.description: Total resale no longer exists for individuals and the surplus is bought back at one cent per kilowatt-hour, 20 times less than the price you pay for it. Every kWh should therefore be used at home: that is the job of the battery, and of the controlled water heater and charger.

vatRefund.title: VAT recovery (on request)
vatRefund.description: For installations above 3 kWp: setting up the producer structure and handling the file through to the refund.

notice.title: Good to know
notice.description: MaPrimeRénov' and CEE do not apply to solar panels: they apply to heat pumps.

roof.question: Is my roof suitable?
roof.answer: South, south-east or south-west facing, a pitch of 15 to 45°, tiles, slate, steel sheeting: we check on satellite view, then during the technical visit.

connection.question: How long until I am connected?
connection.answer: About 10 days between the first contact and signature, then 1 to 3 months of paperwork (town hall, Enedis) before installation.

installer.question: Who installs the system?
installer.answer: Our own technicians, based in Saint-Laurent-du-Var. We do not subcontract installation.

breakdown.question: What happens if something breaks down?
breakdown.answer: The first year of maintenance is included. After that, Soliance Care monitors the installation and responds within 2 working days.

financing.question: Can I finance the project?
financing.answer: Yes, with our partner Sofinco for individuals, or through leasing with BPCE Lease for businesses.

care.title: An installation lasts 25 years. We stay by your side.
care.body: Every installation is connected to our supervision: AI detects production gaps, a local technician responds within 2 working days, and the annual service (cleaning, connection checks, inverter update) keeps the original yield.

supervision.title: 24/7 supervision
supervision.description: Production, self-consumption and battery monitored continuously, with an alert before you notice anything.
supervision.imageAlt: Supervision screen: production, consumption, battery status

repair.title: Repair within 2 days
repair.description: Our own technicians, based in Saint-Laurent-du-Var, handle the diagnosis and the manufacturer warranty.
repair.imageAlt: Soliance technician working on the inverter

maintenance.title: Annual service
maintenance.description: Panel cleaning, inspection of mountings and protections, performance report.
